root_cause.text: In f2fs_compress_write_end_io(), calling dec_page_count(sbi, type) before all subsequent accesses to sbi (specifically page_array_free) creates a race where the counter drop can allow a concurrent unmount to free sbi, leading to a use-after-free when the function later dereferences sbi->page_array_slab.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that dec_page_count(sbi, type) can decrement the F2FS_WB_CP_DATA counter to zero, unblocking f2fs_wait_on_all_pages() in f2fs_put_super() on a concurrent unmount CPU, which then destroys sbi->page_array_slab and frees sbi. Meanwhile, the bio completion callback still reaches page_array_free(sbi, ...), dereferencing the destroyed slab cache. The patch fixes this by moving dec_page_count to after page_array_free for the last folio, ensuring all sbi accesses complete before the counter decrement.
